svg.title: GCP HA VPN to AWS virtual private gateway over four tunnels
svg.desc: Google Cloud project with region asia-south1, VPC gcp-vpc, subnet 10.10.0.0/20 with a Compute Engine VM, firewall rule, Cloud Router ASN 65010, Secret Manager and an HA VPN gateway with two interfaces. AWS Cloud with region ap-south-1, VPC 10.20.0.0/16, a private subnet with an EC2 instance, a route table, a virtual private gateway ASN 64600 and two customer gateways. Four tunnels cross the internet in two VPN connections.
